question: Should OpenClaw accept Featherless as an official external provider package for the 2026.6.11 release train after the current gate failure is resolved?
rationale: The implementation follows the plugin boundary and has real provider proof, but it creates a new public provider/auth/package release surface that automation should not accept without maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept after gates
options.body: Proceed with the official provider once current-head CI is green and the 2026.6.11 package publication timing is confirmed.

options.title: Defer the launch
options.body: Keep the PR open but hold merge until a later release train can own the new provider package and docs rollout.

options.title: Decline official provider
options.body: Close the official-provider direction and keep Featherless on generic custom-provider setup or a separately maintained plugin path.

recommendation.title: Accept after gates
recommendation.body: Proceed with the official provider once current-head CI is green and the 2026.6.11 package publication timing is confirmed.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the linked maintainer issue and PR and have recent merged ownership of official external provider/package launches.
